get.summary: Get Ad Account Spend Limit Windows
get.description: View spend limit windows with inclusive start dates and exclusive end dates, ordered by start time ascending. Active and upcoming Daily recurrence rules are returned separately in daily_limits; daily_limit retains the active or earliest upcoming rule for legacy clients. data remains dated windows only. Creating account spending limits requires an ad account on postpaid invoice billing.

post.summary: Create Ad Account Spend Limit Window
post.description: Create a spend limit window with an inclusive start date and exclusive end date. Available only for ad accounts on postpaid invoice billing.

post.summary: Update Ad Account Spend Limit Window
post.description: Edit a spend limit window with an inclusive start date and exclusive end date. Available only for ad accounts on postpaid invoice billing.

post.summary: Delete Ad Account Spend Limit Window
post.description: Delete an active or scheduled spend limit window before it ends. Available only for ad accounts on postpaid invoice billing.

post.summary: Set Ad Account Daily Spend Limit
post.description: Set an account-wide daily billable ad-spend limit, with an optional exclusive end date. Send window_id=null to create a separate non-overlapping schedule, or a rule ID to edit. Omitting window_id retains legacy singleton upsert and rejects ambiguous configurations. Creating or editing a daily limit requires an ad account on postpaid invoice billing. Omit end_date to retain an existing end, or send null for no end. First activation takes effect no earlier than the next account-local day. Increases and decreases apply on save and retain today's counted spend; a decrease below recorded spend is rejected. Like Date range limits, edits are not retroactive: delayed charges use the settings effective at their event time, and the spend check is not atomic with concurrent billing. The saved amount repeats each day in the recorded account timezone, without carryover, proration, or campaign-style flexibility. Use the latest configuration revision.

post.summary: Delete Ad Account Daily Spend Limit
post.description: Remove the selected daily limit on save. Omit window_id only when at most one active or upcoming Daily rule exists. Historical protected days and their billable allowances are retained for late events and corrections. Does not delete dated or IO limits.

get.description: Get Hotel-property Insights for the authenticated ad account. Available only to accounts enrolled in Hotel reporting. Impressions/clicks combine settled and estimated data; spend and cost rates remain settled-only. Inspect coverage before interpreting partial or empty results. Property conversions, geography breakdowns, and metadata sorting are not supported. Current catalog completion is optional and feed-scoped.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: JSON object strings with "field", "operator", "value"; all filters are ANDed. At most 2000 text values are allowed across all filters. hotel_name, hotel_brand, hotel_category, hotel_city, hotel_region and hotel_country_code support IN with string arrays (exact, case-sensitive current metadata). impressions, clicks, spend, ctr, cpc and cpm support GREATER_THAN/LESS_THAN with finite numbers. Metrics filter property/time-bucket totals before pagination and hierarchy expansion; trends use daily property totals. CTR is a ratio; CPC/CPM use settled denominators. Missing metadata does not match a text filter.
